summary: Frontend-only role-matrix and ConnectGBB moderation regression tested on local + preview. Local role matrix passes for pending/coach/admin route gating and memberships page visibility, but preview run is blocked by anti-bot/rate-limit behavior and feed integration is partially broken due a comments schema mismatch.

integration_issues.flow: Community feed load for coach/admin moderation source data
integration_issues.issue: Feed query fails with console error code 42703: column community_comments.author_name does not exist; report buttons are not rendered because posts/comments fetch fails.
Preview login page intermittently blocked by repeated 429/401 + challenge behavior; login testids become unavailable and automation times out before filling credentials.
Queue container loads, but no actionable report rows existed in tested local run (0 resolve/reject buttons), so resolve/reject interaction could not be functionally exercised in this session.

action_items: Fix community feed comments select contract (code expects author_name/author_role columns in community_comments).
After schema/query fix, re-run coach report submission then validate admin queue resolve/reject updates against community_post_reports.
Stabilize preview environment anti-bot/rate-limit behavior for automated role-matrix coverage (or provide approved automation bypass).
critical_code_review_comments: useCommunityFeed currently hard-selects community_comments.author_name and author_role; if DB migrated away from these fields, feed fails hard and blocks moderation report creation path.
Membership resolution behavior appears corrected for requested local roles: pending remains locked while coach reaches create-post UI.
Admin memberships page loads successfully without relying on legacy analytics fallback in this run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Local role matrix route checks pass; preview still intermittently blocked before login selectors appear. Feed query schema mismatch (community_comments.author_name) prevents post/comment rendering and blocks complete moderation queue action validation from fresh reports.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (feed integration): Repro by logging in as coach and opening /connectgbb/feed. Console shows 400 + Postgres error 42703 for missing community_comments.author_name, causing useCommunityFeed failure and empty post/report action surface. Mitigation: align query mapper/select list with actual community_comments schema or restore expected columns. RCA-2 (preview instability): Repro by running /app/tests/test_connectgbb_role_matrix_e2e.py against preview URL; repeated 429 + challenge/401 events occur, then login-form-email-input is never available. Mitigation: reduce request burst, add environment allowlisting/challenge bypass for CI automation, and verify rate-limit settings.
